📊 Candlestick Rejection Strength Guide

This visual breaks down how to judge the strength of a rejection candle by using its total range. A simple but extremely useful filter for traders who rely on price action.

You’ll see three levels of rejection:

✅ Strong Rejection
The candle closes above the previous candle’s open and finishes high within its range — showing buyers stepped in aggressively.

🟡 Good Rejection
Still closes above the previous open, but doesn’t reach the top third of its range. Buyers are present, but not as strong.

🔻 Weak Rejection
Closes above the previous open, but only around the midpoint. Momentum is there, but not convincing enough for high-confidence entries.

Understanding these subtle differences helps traders filter out weak signals and focus on candles that actually show power and intent. A small detail that makes a big difference. 💌 @nursejannah

Keamanan dan kedaulatan yang dinikmati Malaysia hari ini adalah hasil perjuangan dan pengorbanan tidak ternilai para perajurit negara yang sentiasa berdiri teguh mempertahankan tanah air.

Mengimbau tragedi Bukit Jenalik di Kuala Kangsar pada 2 Julai 2000, bekas anggota 69 Komando (Sarjan Mejar) Zol’aini Sabar, 68, berkata, mempertahankan kedaulatan negara juga menuntut seluruh rakyat Malaysia bersatu padu dan menghargai erti pengorbanan dan keamanan.
